description: The action registry. Source of truth for what operations exist and what each guarantees. tests/test_contract.py asserts a bijection between this file and the @action-decorated symbols in drf/ - neither can drift from the other.

determinism.deterministic: Same inputs always produce the same output. Enforced by replay check in drf/contract.py, not assumed.
determinism.probabilistic: Output may vary for identical inputs. Must declare a confidence in [0.0, 1.0].

authority.authoritative: May influence the ranking of results.
authority.advisory: May never influence ranking. Results are boxed in Advisory[T] and can only be appended below authoritative results.

axes.note: The axes are orthogonal. A deterministic action may be advisory; a probabilistic action may never be authoritative.

invariant_determinism_rule: Per SAT-Graph RAG (arXiv 2510.06002): an action whose inputs consist exclusively of formal IDs plus frozen index state MUST be labelled deterministic. tests/test_contract.py enforces this.

actions.name: ingest.build_index
actions.summary: Build the content-addressed index from a source knowledge graph.
actions.guarantee: Two builds from identical source bytes produce identical manifest content_hash.

actions.name: store.load_manifest
actions.summary: Read and validate the index manifest.
actions.guarantee: Fails loudly if the manifest content_hash does not match the index it describes.

actions.name: tokenize.terms
actions.summary: Normalise text to an ordered term list. Shared by index and query paths.
actions.guarantee: One tokenizer definition; indexing and querying cannot diverge.

actions.name: lexical.candidates
actions.summary: Union of postings over the sorted query terms.
actions.guarantee: Complete, not truncated: this is the exact support of BM25, so no candidate with nonzero score can be lost. There is no LIMIT and therefore no ordering dependency.

actions.name: lexical.bm25_score
actions.summary: Okapi BM25 with k1, b and document-length normalisation.
actions.guarantee: Contributions summed with math.fsum in sorted-term order, then quantised to int. Bit-identical across platforms.

actions.name: graph.expand
actions.summary: Bounded breadth-first expansion from the top-ranked seeds.
actions.guarantee: Neighbours visited in sorted node_id order; seed slice is taken from an already-total order.

actions.name: stage1.rank
actions.summary: Produce the authoritative total order D.
actions.guarantee: Sort key ends in the content-addressed node_id, which is injective over the candidate set. The induced order is strict and total, so output is independent of input permutation and of sort stability.

actions.name: neural.propose_from_anchors
actions.summary: Propose nodes similar to the top-ranked members of D, using frozen vectors.
actions.guarantee: Deterministic because it reads frozen vectors only. Advisory because it may never reorder D. This action is the clearest demonstration that the two axes are independent.

actions.name: neural.encode_query_remote
actions.summary: Encode query text via a remote embedding server.

determinism_evidence.endpoint: llama.cpp server, BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 Q4_0 GGUF, dim=1024
determinism_evidence.protocol: 5 sequential identical requests; plus single-input vs in-batch comparison
determinism_evidence.result: All 5 responses byte-identical. Batched and unbatched vectors byte-identical.
determinism_evidence.caveat: This is a property of one server build under light load, not of remote embedders in general. The replay check in drf/contract.py stays armed so that any drift fails loudly rather than silently degrading reproducibility.

actions.guarantee: Advisory regardless of determinism. A network failure, timeout, or garbage response can at worst contribute nothing.

actions.name: merge.append_advisory
actions.summary: Append advisory proposals below the authoritative order.
actions.guarantee: order(D) is preserved exactly. Enforced by a runtime postcondition that runs on every query, not only in tests. The only module permitted to unwrap Advisory values.
